These online materials extend and support the two R workshops delivered by the Maths and Statistics Advice (MASA) service at the University of Surrey. They are used during the workshops and can also be used independently as a self-study resource or for future reference.

Follow the links below to access the corresponding course materials.

- [Getting started with R & RStudio](pages/GSW_R_1_Overview.qmd)
- [Intermediate R & RStudio](pages/Intermediate_R_1_Overview.qmd)
